main.description: Clears the requesting user's inbox up to a point in time. Every notification raised at or before it is marked seen and left out of listNotifications, getUnreadCount and getUnseen from then on.

clearedAt.description: Notifications raised at or before this time are cleared. A time in the future is treated as now, and a time before an earlier clear leaves that clear in place.
The point the inbox is now cleared up to.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: The request has no valid service auth.
